name: szsdlc
description: Project-agnostic agentic SDLC framework: entities are the single source of truth, every index is generated, and the deterministic operations are script calls with fixed token cost.

render_on_turn_end.title: Render at the end of every turn
render_on_turn_end.description: Regenerate the views when Claude finishes responding, not only when a source file is written. A file somebody typed into is left alone for szsdlc validate to report. This governs rendering only: the project is still committed and synced with its backend as the turn ends.
